title: Implement file upload to DO Spaces with presigned POST URLs
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/tenant/upload/request — returns presigned POST URL and fields for client-side upload
POST /api/tenant/upload/confirm — called after upload, verifies file exists and saves resume record
Uploaded files stored in tenant-prefixed path: {tenant_id}/{uuid}/{filename}
File type validation: only PDF, DOCX, DOC allowed (checked server-side)
Upload confirmation triggers text extraction pipeline asynchronously
